note: Curated knowledge base of real SaaS tools and current pricing for Parakh AI agents. Prices are as of July 2026.

tools.name: Next.js
tools.description: React meta-framework with App Router, SSR, ISR, and API routes. The industry standard for production web apps.
tools.best_for: Full-stack web apps, SaaS products, SEO-critical sites

tools.name: Vite + React
tools.description: Blazing-fast build tool for SPAs. No SSR by default.
tools.best_for: Single-page apps, dashboards, internal tools

tools.name: Astro
tools.description: Content-focused framework with zero JS by default. Ships HTML-first.
tools.best_for: Blogs, landing pages, content-heavy marketing sites

tools.name: React Native + Expo
tools.description: Cross-platform mobile framework. Write once, deploy to iOS and Android.
tools.free_tier: Open source, free forever (Expo has free tier for builds)
tools.best_for: Mobile apps (iOS + Android) when a mobile-first experience is critical

tools.name: Supabase
tools.description: Open-source Firebase alternative. Postgres DB, Auth, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions. Includes pgvector for AI.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — 500 MB DB, 50K MAUs, 1 GB Storage, 5 GB Bandwidth, 2 projects. Pauses after 1 week inactivity.
tools.paid_tier: Pro: $25/mo — 8 GB DB, 100K MAUs, 100 GB Storage, 250 GB Bandwidth
tools.best_for: SaaS apps, relational data, apps needing Auth + DB + Realtime in one place

tools.name: Firebase
tools.description: Google's BaaS. Firestore (NoSQL), Auth, Cloud Functions, Hosting.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo (Spark Plan) — 1 GB Firestore storage, 50K reads/day, 20K writes/day, 10 GB hosting bandwidth
tools.best_for: Mobile-first apps, apps needing offline sync, Google Cloud ecosystem

tools.name: Appwrite
tools.description: Open-source, self-hostable BaaS. DB, Auth, Functions, Storage, Messaging.
tools.best_for: Teams wanting self-hosting option and zero vendor lock-in

tools.name: Convex
tools.description: Reactive backend with automatic real-time sync. TypeScript-native.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — 1M function calls, 1 GB DB, 1 GB file storage
tools.best_for: Highly reactive apps, real-time dashboards, collaborative tools

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: AI-native IDE built on VS Code. Understands your entire codebase. Multi-file refactors, AI Agent mode.
tools.free_tier: Hobby: $0/mo — Limited daily usage, core features included
tools.paid_tier: Pro: $20/mo — Full credit pool for daily agent use
tools.best_for: Primary development IDE for solo founders and small teams

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.description: AI-native IDE competitor to Cursor. Daily/weekly usage quotas instead of credits.
tools.best_for: Developers who prefer Windsurf's UX or want an alternative to Cursor

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: AI pair programmer integrated into VS Code and JetBrains. Inline suggestions and chat.
tools.free_tier: Free for open-source contributors and students
tools.best_for: Developers already in the GitHub ecosystem who want lightweight AI assistance

tools.name: v0.dev (Vercel)
tools.description: AI UI component generator. Generates production-ready React + Tailwind components from text prompts.
tools.paid_tier: Pro: $20/mo — Higher credit allowance, advanced models
tools.best_for: Rapidly prototyping beautiful UI components without manual CSS

tools.name: Bolt.new
tools.description: Browser-based AI app builder. Generates full-stack apps from prompts using WebContainers.
tools.best_for: Non-technical founders who need a working prototype fast

tools.name: Lovable
tools.description: AI app builder focused on non-technical founders. Credit-based model.
tools.best_for: Non-technical founders building full-stack MVPs

hosting_deployment.label: Hosting & Deployment
hosting_deployment.recommended_default: Vercel (for Next.js), Netlify (for commercial free tier)

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: Edge-first deployment platform. Creator of Next.js. Instant global deploys via Git push.
tools.free_tier: Hobby: $0/mo — 100 GB bandwidth, 1M edge requests. NON-COMMERCIAL USE ONLY.
tools.paid_tier: Pro: $20/user/mo — 1 TB bandwidth, commercial use allowed
tools.best_for: Next.js apps, SSR/ISR heavy sites, production commercial apps (on Pro)

tools.name: Netlify
tools.description: Frontend deployment platform. Supports all frameworks. Commercial use allowed on free tier.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — 100 GB bandwidth, 300 build minutes. COMMERCIAL USE ALLOWED.
tools.best_for: Early-stage commercial projects that need free hosting, static sites, Jamstack

tools.name: Railway
tools.description: Full-stack cloud platform. Deploy backends, databases, cron jobs with one click.
tools.best_for: Python/Node backends, background workers, PostgreSQL hosting

tools.name: Render
tools.description: Cloud platform for web services, static sites, PostgreSQL, Redis, cron jobs.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — Free web services (spin down after inactivity), free PostgreSQL (90-day limit)
tools.best_for: Simple backend APIs, hobby projects needing a free backend host

tools.name: Fly.io
tools.description: Edge compute platform. Run containers globally. Low-latency deployments.
tools.paid_tier: Pay-as-you-go based on VM size and usage
tools.best_for: Globally distributed backends, low-latency APIs

tools.name: Razorpay
tools.description: India's leading payment gateway. UPI, Cards, Netbanking, e-NACH. Deep local banking integration.
tools.free_tier: No setup fee, no AMC. Pay per transaction only.
tools.best_for: Any startup targeting Indian customers. UPI integration is essential in India.
tools.pricing_inr: 2% per domestic transaction + 18% GST on fee

tools.name: Stripe
tools.description: Global payment infrastructure. Cards, subscriptions, invoicing. Invite-only in India.
tools.free_tier: No setup fee. Pay per transaction only.
tools.transaction_fee: Domestic US: 2.9% + $0.30 | India International: ~4.3% + 2% currency conversion
tools.best_for: Global SaaS targeting US/EU customers. Developer-first API.
tools.pricing_inr: Effectively ~6% all-in for INR settlements from international cards

tools.name: Lemon Squeezy
tools.description: Merchant of Record (MoR). Handles global tax compliance, VAT, invoicing, and fraud on your behalf.
tools.free_tier: No setup fee. Pay per transaction only.
tools.transaction_fee: 5% + $0.50 per transaction. +1.5% for international cards. +0.5% for subscriptions.
tools.best_for: Solo indie hackers selling digital products globally who don't want to handle tax compliance.

tools.name: Dodo Payments
tools.description: Merchant of Record for Indian founders selling globally. Handles international tax compliance.
tools.best_for: Indian founders who want to sell globally without managing international tax filings.

marketing_growth.label: Marketing & Growth / Cold Outreach Tools
marketing_growth.recommended_default: Apollo.io (free tier for leads) + Manual LinkedIn DMs (free)

tools.name: Apollo.io
tools.description: Sales intelligence + lead database + email sequences. Find anyone's email.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — ~900 annual credits, basic search, 2 email sequences
tools.best_for: Finding leads, building prospect lists, basic cold email outreach

tools.name: Instantly.ai
tools.description: Cold email platform. Unlimited email accounts, automated warmup, high deliverability.
tools.best_for: High-volume cold email campaigns with multiple sender accounts

tools.name: PhantomBuster
tools.description: Web automation and scraping. Automate LinkedIn, Twitter, Google Maps data extraction.
tools.best_for: Scraping LinkedIn profiles, automating multi-step outreach workflows

tools.name: LinkedIn (Manual DMs)
tools.description: Free. Just DM your target customers directly. The highest-converting channel for B2B.
tools.free_tier: Free — ~100 connection requests/week on free LinkedIn
tools.best_for: EVERY bootstrapped B2B founder. Start here before spending money.

tools.name: Twitter / X
tools.description: Free. Build in public, engage with your target audience, run polls.
tools.paid_tier: X Premium: $8/mo for verification and reach boost
tools.best_for: Founder-led marketing, build-in-public strategy, developer audiences

tools.name: Reddit
tools.description: Free. Participate in relevant subreddits. Answer questions. Share your product genuinely.
tools.best_for: Finding early adopters for niche products. r/SaaS, r/startups, r/Entrepreneur

tools.name: shadcn/ui
tools.description: Copy-paste React component library built on Radix UI + Tailwind. You own the code.
tools.best_for: Building beautiful, accessible UIs fast without vendor lock-in

tools.name: TailwindCSS
tools.description: Utility-first CSS framework. The industry standard for rapid UI development.
tools.best_for: All web projects. Pair with shadcn/ui for maximum velocity.

tools.name: Figma
tools.description: Collaborative design tool. Industry standard for UI/UX design and prototyping.
tools.free_tier: Free — 3 Figma files, unlimited personal files
tools.best_for: Design mockups before coding. Skip this if you use v0 or Cursor to design directly in code.

tools.name: Cloudflare Registrar
tools.description: At-cost domain registration. No markup. Consistent pricing forever.
tools.best_for: Long-term domain ownership with zero renewal surprises

tools.name: Namecheap
tools.description: Popular domain registrar. Often cheaper year 1 with promo codes. Free WHOIS privacy.
tools.best_for: Budget-friendly first-year domain registration

tools.name: Resend
tools.description: Developer-first email API. Clean SDK, React Email integration.
tools.best_for: Transactional emails (welcome, password reset, receipts)

tools.name: Plunk
tools.description: Open-source email platform. Transactional + marketing emails.
tools.free_tier: Self-hosted: Free | Cloud: Free tier available
tools.best_for: Budget alternative to Resend for bootstrapped founders

tools.name: PostHog
tools.description: All-in-one product analytics. Event tracking, session recordings, feature flags, A/B testing, surveys.
tools.free_tier: $0/mo — 1M events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature flag requests. Resets monthly. Unlimited team seats.
tools.paid_tier: Pay-as-you-go after free limits. No per-seat pricing.
tools.best_for: EVERY startup. The free tier is incredibly generous. Replace Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and Hotjar with one tool.

tools.name: Plausible
tools.description: Privacy-friendly, lightweight web analytics. No cookies. GDPR compliant by default.
tools.best_for: Simple, privacy-first website analytics without cookie banners

tools.name: Mixpanel
tools.description: Advanced product analytics. Funnels, retention, cohorts.
tools.best_for: Deep funnel analysis and user behavior tracking at scale

auth_providers.label: Authentication Providers
auth_providers.recommended_default: Supabase Auth (if using Supabase) or Clerk (standalone)

tools.name: Supabase Auth
tools.description: Built into Supabase. Email/password, magic link, OAuth (Google, GitHub, etc.), Row Level Security.
tools.best_for: Any app already using Supabase. Zero additional cost.

tools.name: Clerk
tools.description: Drop-in auth UI components. Pre-built sign-in/sign-up pages, user management, multi-factor auth.
tools.best_for: Apps that need beautiful, pre-built auth UI without custom development

tools.name: Auth0 (Okta)
tools.description: Enterprise-grade identity platform. SSO, MFA, machine-to-machine auth.
tools.best_for: Enterprise SaaS apps requiring advanced security features (SSO/SAML)
